kypExtensions.summary: The SIX-ORGAN DRY TOUR reading of the grid's own ORGAN SYSTEM column — SIX lanes, each with its printed arrow: EYE ('↑ pupil dilation, cycloplegia'), AIRWAY ('Bronchodilation, ↓ secretions'), HEART ('↑ heart rate'), STOMACH ('↓ acid secretion'), GUT ('↓ motility'), BLADDER ('↓ urgency in cystitis'). Every organ name and arrow is the book's own print; the tour compression (top of the head to the pelvis, every lane one direction — dry/open/fast) is KYP's. The mnemonic-to-grid MAPPING (each of the seven simile lines pinned to its grid arrow: 'Hot as a hare' → the sweat glands' anhidrosis behind '↑ body temperature', 'Fast as a fiddle' → the Heart row, 'Dry as a bone' → the secretion arrows, 'Red as a beet' → the cutaneous flush, 'Blind as a bat' → the Eye row, 'Mad as a hatter' → the disorientation finding, 'Full as a flask' → the Bladder row overshot into retention) is KYP's overlay on two printed sets — the similes and the arrows are the book's own, the pinning is KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The book prints the grid and the mnemonic as separate elements; the tour and the simile-to-arrow mapping that unify them are KYP's synthesis.
